steps.en: OCMS checks addresses of returned court summonses and counts records checked
steps.id: OCMS mengecek alamat court summons yang kembali dan menghitung records yang dicek
steps.why_en: No job checks addresses of returned court summonses.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada job yang mengecek alamat court summons yang kembali.

steps.en: OCMS generates a daily summary of records checked, received and address changes
steps.id: OCMS membuat ringkasan harian records dicek, diterima, dan address change
steps.why_en: No daily summary report for returned court summonses is built.
steps.why_id: Laporan ringkasan harian untuk court summons yang kembali belum dibuat.

steps.en: The report is routed to the Court Processing Officer dashboard
steps.id: Report dirutekan ke dashboard Court Processing Officer
steps.why_en: Court report menu titles exist but lead to no page.
steps.why_id: Judul menu court report ada tetapi tidak mengarah ke halaman.

steps.en: Officer downloads the summary report for reference
steps.id: Officer mendownload summary report sebagai referensi
steps.why_en: Nothing to download: the court summary report does not exist.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang bisa didownload: report ringkasan court belum ada.
